entries.why: key handler of the value window (cmp r2, #0; popne; LPF/HPF/BPF to the filter, else close and post the key again), referenced from the window's vtable at 0xC00C9C94; fwmap maps it and the 92 bytes are equal masked. The synth has no second such handler: the place of 0xC006543C is in no run

encoder handler of the screen manager (cmp r1, #0; ldrb r3, [r0, #0x19]; the dial to the screen, else to the window), found by its head words; the synth's has no window 0x2a and checks the lock twice, value_popup.py checks both forms word by word
